prompt.text:
Implement `solution.py` with `prepare_examples(records, holdout_stride)`.

Each record must be a mapping containing exactly `pixels`, `sector`, and `distance`. `sector` and `distance` must be non-empty strings. `pixels` must be a non-empty rectangular sequence of non-empty rows containing integers from 0 through 255, excluding booleans. `holdout_stride` must be an integer of at least 2, excluding booleans.

Return `{"sector": {"train": ..., "validation": ...}, "distance": {"train": ..., "validation": ...}}`. Every output example has keys `pixels` and `label`. Records whose one-based input position is divisible by `holdout_stride` go to validation; all others go to training. Preserve input order. Each target receives an independent deep copy of the pixel matrix, so mutations to the input or any returned example cannot affect another returned example. Empty input is valid and produces four empty lists. Do not mutate the input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
